target.title: fix(agents): resolve legacy modelstudio profile aliases
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Legacy explicit auth profile ids like modelstudio:default fail to resolve after provider canonicalization to qwen, causing valid stored credentials to be ignored and agent turns to fail with No credentials found for profile \"modelstudio:default\".

## Summary
- resolve explicit legacy provider-prefixed profile ids through provider auth aliases when direct lookup misses
- preserve explicit profile precedence: if modelstudio:default exists directly, use it instead of alias fallback
- add focused regression coverage for both fallback path and precedence path

## Evidence
- Repro: before this change, resolving { provider: "modelstudio", profileId: "modelstudio:default" } with only qwen:default in store throws No credentials found for profile "modelstudio:default".
- Validation: after change, same setup resolves to qwen:default and returns the expected key
- Guardrail: explicit modelstudio:default credential remains preferred when both modelstudio:default and qwen:default exist
- Local test run:
  - [x] pnpm exec vitest run src/agents/model-auth.profiles.test.ts -t "84081|modelstudio profile"

Related: #84081
